last.verdict: Shopify held 32% revenue growth while operating profit rose 66%, and guided to a similar low-thirties pace for next quarter.

takeaways.label: Profits growing much faster
takeaways.text: Operating income jumped 66% to $568 million and free cash flow margin reached 22%, up from 18% a year ago, as revenue grew 32% to $3.74 billion.

takeaways.label: Growth cooled slightly
takeaways.text: Revenue growth slowed from 34% last quarter to 32%. Total sales on the platform grew 29% to $119 billion. Next quarter is guided to low-thirties growth.

takeaways.label: Gross profit lags revenue
takeaways.text: Gross profit grew 28%, slower than revenue, and Q4 gross profit is guided to high-twenties growth. Payments-driven merchant revenue (up 35%) is growing faster than the higher-margin subscription revenue (up 20%).

takeaways.label: Big buyback, lower loan losses
takeaways.text: Shopify repurchased $562 million of its own stock this quarter, versus none a year ago. Transaction and loan losses fell to $120 million from $148 million.

history.verdict: Growth sped up and the outlook stayed strong, so a beaten-down stock jumped.

reasons.label: Growth speeding up
reasons.text: Revenue rose 34%, ahead of the high-twenties growth Shopify had guided for this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong profit and cash
reasons.text: Free cash flow margin reached 18%, up from 16%, and operating income rose 68%.

reasons.label: Confident next-quarter outlook
reasons.text: Shopify guided Q3 revenue growth to the low thirties and free cash flow margin to the high-teens to low-twenties.
